text: The Addu City Land Reclamation and Shore Protection Project (ASRP) is a comprehensive initiative aimed at addressing chronic shoreline erosion, sea-level rise, and storm surge risks in Addu City, Maldives. The project involves land reclamation and the construction of coastal defenses to mitigate erosion and flooding, while also expanding land for housing, public amenities, and economic activities. It is a collaborative effort involving the Government of Maldives, the Government of India, and private sector contractors.
